title: New Lollipop Chainsaw Game Announced for 2027 Release on PS5
content: Nada Holdings and Dragami Games announced a new game in the Lollipop Chainsaw franchise titled Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back during Tokyo Game Show on Thursday. The game will launch for the PlayStation 5 in 2027. Final Fantasy XV director Hajime Tabata is directing the game, with his JP Universe company developing.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Series The Remarried Empress Releases Main Trailer, Key Visual
content: Disney+ and Hulu released the main trailer and key visual on Wednesday for the webtoon- and web novel-based live-action series The Remarried Empress ahead of its November 4 debut .
author: ANN

title: Entergram Announces Koyo -RE-Nium Visual Novel Starring Hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori
content: Entergram opened a teaser website on Thursday to announce the KOYO -RE- NIUM visual novel starring hololive VTuber Hakui Koyori, who also supervises the game. No other details of the game were announced, and the official website will open on October 22.

title: FuRyu Streams Crymelight Game's Opening Video
content: FuRyu began streaming the opening video for its CRYMELIGHT game on Thursday. The video announces and previews the game's theme song "Love and Guilt" by Hitomi Sekine as her character Mary.
author: ANN

title: Un:Me Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Delay, Yumiri Hanamori Casting
content: Shueisha Games unveiled a new trailer for historia Inc.'s Un:Me horror game on Wednesday. The video announces the game's delay to 2027, and announces that voice actress Yumiri Hanamori is playing the game's main character. The game will release for Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Game Launches on March 4
content: Koei Tecmo announced on Wednesday that Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember, its sequel game to Team Ninja's 2023 game Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, will launch on March 4, 2027 for the Xbox series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox PC (and Xbox Cloud), and PC via Steam . A playable alpha demo is available now.
author: ANN

title: Final Fantasy Resonance Game's TGS Trailer Previews Theme Song
content: Square Enix began streaming the Tokyo Game Show trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance , a new HD-2D offline game based on the first story arc of the defunct Final Fantasy Brave Exvius smartphone game, on Thursday. The trailer announces and previews the game's theme song "Inside" by WurtS .
author: ANN
